invitation.title: A little note
invitation.message:
Thirty trips around the sun deserve a proper party.

Come eat too much cake, tell embarrassing stories and stay far too late. Bring nothing but yourself and comfortable shoes — the playlist is already dangerous.

profile.title: A bit about {{name}}
profile.tagline: Baker of questionable sourdough, collector of houseplants.
facts: Has visited 21 countries and lost a passport in three of them
Can name every song from the 90s within two seconds
Makes the best chai in the postcode (her words)
Will absolutely start the conga line
